description: Suggest holiday regions by (partial) name, typo-tolerant. Names are matched in the response language, with German (the native names, e.g. "Seenplatte") always accepted as well. Returns region ids usable as regionId in search_accommodations, with accommodation counts.

level.description: Restrict to one region hierarchy level (1..8); omit for any

locale.description: Language the user is writing in (de, en, fr, pl, it, es, nl, hr); defaults to de. Selects the language of names and texts in the response and the language region names are matched in — pass it on every call.

query.description: Search text; honest 2-char minimum, no silent truncation

name: autocomplete_regions
title: Region autocomplete
